purpose: Prevent duplicate generation and make every P08 production object advance through an explicit acceptance pipeline.

duplicatePrevention.hardRule: Before any ImageGen call, read this ledger. If an item is GENERATED_DRAFT or later, do not generate the same role again unless its status is explicitly changed to REWORK_REQUIRED with a reason.
duplicatePrevention.ownerAcceptedTransportRule: A transport/upload failure must never trigger regeneration of owner-accepted artwork. Fix the transport path instead.
duplicatePrevention.reuseFirst: Before generating a new module, search existing accepted V30 production assets for a reusable visual family match.
duplicatePrevention.acceptedAssetRule: ACCEPTED assets are immutable for routine continuation; reopen only for an explicit visual defect or owner instruction.
